name: 6-DoF Hand
summary: Grab-and-move hand technique above a stereoscopic table: the dominant hand moves and rotates the object, the other hand scales it.
howItWorks: Above an interactive stereoscopic tabletop, the dominant hand grabs the object directly and controls all six degrees of freedom; the distance between the two hands sets its scale.

relationships.note: Bimanual scaling on top of direct grabbing.

review.notes: Added from Weise, Zender & Lucke 2019 (Oct 2026). Attributes drafted by Claude from the survey descriptions and the original paper's abstract; not yet checked against the paper.
